turns.text:
NEW YORK STATE SENATE

THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD

ALBANY, NEW YORK

June 4, 2023

11:00 a.m.

REGULAR SESSION SENATOR NEIL D. BRESLIN, Acting President ALEJANDRA N. PAULINO, ESQ., Secretary

P R O C E E D I N G S

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT BRESLIN
turns.text:
The Senate will come to order.

The Secretary will begin by reading the Journal.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: In session, Saturday, June 3, 2023, the Senate met pursuant to adjournment. The Journal of Friday, June 2, 2023, was read and approved. On motion, the Senate adjourned.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT BRESLIN
turns.text:
Hearing no objection, the Journal will stand approved as read.

The order of business:

Presentation of petitions.

Messages from the Assembly.

Messages from the Governor.

Reports of standing committees.

Reports of select committees.

Communications and reports from state officers.

Motions and resolutions.

Calendar.

Special orders.

Committee notices.

There being no further business to come before the Senate, we'll stand adjourned.

(Whereupon, at 11:05 a.m., the Senate adjourned.)
